title: Asymptotic probability of irreducibles III: Anti-SEQ
summary: In this paper, we study the structure of the complete asymptotic expansion of the probability that a large combinatorial object is connected or consists of a given number of connected components. For rapidly growing labeled families of structures, the coefficients involved in these expansions are possibly negative integers. Using species theory, we interpret these coefficients as the difference between the counting sequences of two derivative species of structures.
